summary: A switch for an immediate on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, in two sizes, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks submission.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: The on state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled: dimmed, not interactive, not submitted. A disabled ancestor fieldset disables it too.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the control in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, drawn as the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The knob; sits at the end of the track when on (mirrored in rtl). Decorative, aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track filled with primary, thumb at the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on (nothing submitted when off), validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state, formDisabledCallback follows a disabled fieldset, disabled is not submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: The track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009); does not toggle

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its checked state is exposed as aria-checked
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
state is never conveyed by color alone: the thumb position differs
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
on/off is announced by the switch role itself; no extra live region

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and applies at once
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting

useCases.when: The setting must be on before submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states it

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only recorded on submit, such as an agreement or one of several picks
antiPatterns.why: Switches read as immediate settings; checkboxes record a choice

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch that shows or hides a panel, or acts like a pressed button
antiPatterns.why: A switch is a form value, not a button state
A switch has two states only

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that flips with the state, such as Enable / Disable
antiPatterns.why: The switch role already announces on/off
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default input is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset
shadcn uses 32x18.4 and 24x14; heights rounded to the size scale (the reference is 32x18.4 and 24x14)

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern; the visual reference for look and sizes; the Checkbox contract for form behavior.

openQuestions.question: Native checkbox with role=switch, or a custom element with role=switch and ARIA state?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox with role=switch: Space, focus, validity, required and form value come native (SB-0007).

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default form reset restores (like native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default and sm, as in the visual reference; no lg.

openQuestions.question: What is submitted when off?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing, as for a native checkbox; the value prop (default "on") is submitted while on.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle?
openQuestions.answer: No. Space toggles; Enter submits the form (SB-0009), consistent with Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is there an indeterminate state or a label-position prop?
openQuestions.answer: No to both: a switch is strictly two-state, and the control sits at the start (mirrored in rtl).
